prompt:
以下はある英語ニュースpodcast記事のFull Story・Point One・Point Twoです。
Point One・Point Twoそれぞれについて、以下6項目を判定してください
(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項
  だけで構成されていない場合PASS(それらに加えて実質的な新しい内容がある
  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)
- qa_specific_not_generic: この記事のLedger固有の内容に基づいており、他の
  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

reasoningには、判定理由を1〜2文の日本語で書いてください(特にFAILの場合は
具体的な理由を明記してください)。

【Full Story】
An 8-1 score can make a game look easy from the start. But Hanshin’s win over Hiroshima on August 16 at Mazda Stadium came in stages: an early lead, steady pitching, and more runs late.

Teruaki Sato changed the game first. In the first inning, he hit a two-run home run to center field and put Hanshin ahead.

It was a fast start, but the game still had to be controlled. Starting pitcher Rihito Ibara gave Hanshin a strong base. He pitched five innings, allowing two hits and one run.

Hiroshima answered in the fifth inning. Elehuris Montero hit a solo home run, giving the home team one run. But Hanshin did not lose its direction.

The Tigers added runs in the seventh and eighth innings. The lead grew, and Hiroshima could not answer again.

By the final out, Hanshin had turned an early advantage into an 8-1 victory. It was not just a game decided by one big swing. Hanshin started well, stayed steady, and finished the job.

【Point One】
The quieter part of this win was Hiroshima’s limited attack. Its only run came from Montero’s solo home run in the fifth inning. Ibara allowed just two hits and one run over five innings. Hanshin was not coming back from an early deficit; its lead faced one setback, but no larger attack followed.

【Point Two】
The late cushion came through timely hits rather than another headline home run. Seishiro Sakamoto drove in a run in the seventh and added an RBI double in the eighth. Pinch-hitter Torai Fushimi also delivered an RBI hit in the seventh. Several parts of the lineup helped turn Sato’s early blast into a complete win.
